meta.title: dsh-rust-exec
meta.description: dsh-rust-exec: a resident Rust worker handles command execution, sha256-guarded file IO, code indexing and search, session-log projection and resource sampling; the host stays a thin JSON-RPC, lane-scheduling, 8-route layer and exposes 11 tools (10 rust_* plus native_help). The UI adds a pinned-header projection view with fuzzy filtering and a fixed 420 px detail pane, a Grafana-style monitor, and the dsh-rust-exec resource strip.
